newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PSG DEFENDER OUT FOR TWO WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG DEFENDER OUT FOR TWO WEEKS.

text.p: Paris St Germain central defender Bruno N'Gotty is out for two weeks with a pulled thigh muscle but is expected to be fit for the first leg of the European Cup Winners' Cup away to Liverpool on April 10.

The France international will miss PSG's trip to defending champions Auxerre on Wednesday and the home game against Rennes on April 5, with right back Jimmy Algerino moving in to the middle of the defence.
Cup Winners' Cup holders PSG are second in the French first division, seven points behind Monaco and four ahead of Nantes.
